disaster_templates.name: Subterranean Seismic Fracture
disaster_templates.description: Tectonic fault rupture cracking bedrock arches and showering corridors with rockfall.

disaster_templates.name: Aquifer Breach & Sump Inundation
disaster_templates.description: High-pressure subterranean water burst overflowing drainage sumps into living sectors.

disaster_templates.name: High-Voltage Transformer Flashover
disaster_templates.description: Short-circuit sparking an oil-fed fire in conduit ducts, filling rooms with choking smoke.

disaster_templates.name: Reactor Shielding Vent Rupture
disaster_templates.description: Radioactive particulate leak venting into central circulation passages.

disaster_templates.name: Scrubber Filter Acid Puncture
disaster_templates.description: Chemical scrubbing solvent fumes flooding ventilation ducts without scrubbed dilution.

disaster_templates.name: Excavation Ceiling Subsidence
disaster_templates.description: Unreinforced ceiling collapse in newly excavated wings trapping personnel beneath debris.

emergency_protocols.name: Hermetic Sector Lockdown
emergency_protocols.description: Slams bulkheads shut to isolate spreading fires, toxic plumes, and floodwaters.

emergency_protocols.name: Halon Gas & Foam Suppression
emergency_protocols.description: Deploys chemical fire suppressants directly combating active electrical flashovers.

emergency_protocols.name: Auxiliary Sump Pumps Overdrive
emergency_protocols.description: Reroutes reserve electrical power to evacuate inundation water from deep sumps.

emergency_protocols.name: Hazmat Scrubber Air Purge
emergency_protocols.description: Powers secondary catalytic HEPA scrubbers to neutralize airborne radionuclides and toxins.

emergency_protocols.name: Rapid Hydraulic Shoring
emergency_protocols.description: Erects emergency steel jacks preventing secondary ceiling cave-ins during earthquakes.
